prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look.
"Schrottmarkt", a big open scrap market square in the underground slums, seen from above. A large plaza of cracked dark concrete and old cobblestones with oily puddles mirroring pink and cyan neon fills the middle and lower two thirds of the image - this is the large walkable area, with wide clear lanes between a few islands of market stalls.
TOP EDGE (back of the market): a scrapyard heap - mountains of rusty car wrecks, washing machines, old screens and drone parts piled along the whole top edge; a packed-dirt clearing in front of the heap is walkable. TOP LEFT: a tall rusty yellow crane with a small cabin and a hanging hook standing on a concrete foot; LEFT of it an old round silver caravan trailer with a striped awning, a camping chair and a little radio on a crate. TOP RIGHT: a small corrugated-sheet-metal office shack with a dented door, a flickering lamp and an oil barrel next to it.
LEFT SIDE: a steaming street kitchen (garkueche) under a red tarp roof with stacks of round bamboo steamer baskets, big pots with rising steam, a long counter, three stools and a wooden bench in front of it, paper lanterns.
CENTER: a market stall with one huge old curved TV screen glowing cyan (picture only, no text) on top of stacked crates, a few stools in front - a central landmark.
Two islands of corrugated metal stalls under patched tarps with colourful lanterns: left-center a stall row with crates full of cables, circuit boards and junk; right-center an electronics stall with glowing screens, radios and wires.
RIGHT SIDE: a narrow tall shop front built into a brick wall with a glowing green neon cross made of light tubes (a symbol, no letters) over a single glass door - the most eye-catching spot, green light spilling onto the wet ground. Below it, a smaller shabby stall with a cheap printer and a cash terminal and a little back yard with crates and a tarp-covered storage shed.
BOTTOM LEFT: a small snack bar booth with a yellow awning and a soldering-iron shaped neon symbol (no letters), two bar stools. BOTTOM RIGHT: a record stall with crates full of vinyl records and a gramophone horn. BOTTOM CENTER-LEFT: a small folding table with three cups (a shell game), and a round iron sewer grate in the floor.
Small stuff at the edges: stacked crates, cable drums, tyres, oil barrels, a floor vent with steam, string lights and sagging cable bundles over the square (drawn thin so they don't hide the floor), graffiti shapes without letters.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: LEFT edge (west) - a lane between brick walls with a pink neon glow leading back toward a nightclub alley; RIGHT edge (east) - an open gap between containers with a view of harbour cranes and a salty blue haze; BOTTOM edge (south, center) - a passage under big rusty pipes leading toward a pipe shanty town.
Time: night, after rain.
